goblin.name: Goblin
traits: Nimble Escape: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
actions: Scimitar: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.
Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

wolf.name: Wolf
traits: Keen Hearing and Smell: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
actions: Shortsword: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.
Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

orc.name: Orc
traits: Aggressive: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.
actions: Greataxe: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

zombie.name: Zombie
traits: Undead Fortitude: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
actions: Slam: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning damage.

bandit.name: Bandit
actions: Scimitar: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) slashing damage.
Light Crossbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

kobold.name: Kobold
traits: Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Pack Tactics: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Dagger: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.
Sling: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) bludgeoning damage.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
traits: Keen Smell: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pack Tactics: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

black_bear.name: Black Bear
traits: Keen Smell: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Multiattack: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

ogre.name: Ogre
actions: Greatclub: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
traits: Martial Advantage: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.
actions: Longsword: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) slashing damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

gnoll.name: Gnoll
traits: Rampage: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.
Spear: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

harpy.name: Harpy
actions: Multiattack: The harpy makes two claw attacks.
Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4+1) slashing damage.

Luring Song: The harpy sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends; a charmed target flies or moves toward the harpy against its will.

owlbear.name: Owlbear
traits: Keen Sight and Smell: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
actions: Multiattack: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.
Beak: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) piercing damage.
Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing damage.

troll.name: Troll
traits: Keen Smell: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Regeneration: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.
actions: Multiattack: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.
Claw: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
giant_spider.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
traits: Spider Climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
Web Sense: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
Web Walker: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

Web (Recharge 5-6): Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

bugbear.name: Bugbear
traits: Brute: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attacks below).
Surprise Attack: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.
actions: Morningstar: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage in melee, or 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage at range.

wight.name: Wight
wight.resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
traits: Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
actions: Multiattack: The wight makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

Life Drain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the wight regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain this way rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the wight's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.
Longsword: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10+2) slashing damage if used with two hands.
Longbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

basilisk.name: Basilisk
traits: Petrifying Gaze: If a creature that can see the basilisk's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the basilisk can force it to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if it isn't already petrified. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained; it must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a further failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until removed by a spell such as greater restoration.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against the basilisk's Petrifying Gaze.

dire_wolf.name: Dire Wolf
traits: Pack Tactics: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Keen Hearing and Smell: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

cult_fanatic.name: Cult Fanatic
traits: Dark Devotion: The fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
actions: Multiattack: The fanatic makes two attacks with its dagger.
Dagger: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+1) piercing damage.

Spellcasting: The fanatic is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). The fanatic has the following cleric spells prepared: command, inflict wounds, shield of faith (1st level, 3 slots); hold person, spiritual weapon (2nd level, 2 slots).

mimic.name: Mimic
traits: Shapechanger: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
Adhesive: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it. Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.
False Appearance: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.
actions: Pseudopod: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is subjected to the mimic's Adhesive trait.
Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

rust_monster.name: Rust Monster
traits: Iron Scent: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

Corrosive Form: A creature that touches the rust monster or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 5 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes and takes a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

Antennae: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target's nonmagical ferrous metal armor or weapon takes a permanent -1 penalty to the AC it offers or to its damage rolls. If the penalty reduces the item's bonus to 0 or it already had none, the item is destroyed.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
fireball.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4+1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously.
magic_missile.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
cure_wounds.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
mage_armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

shield.name: Shield
shield.casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell
shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

bless.name: Bless
bless.components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of holy water)
bless.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can add a d4 to the attack roll or saving throw.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
burning_hands.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
healing_word.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
spiritual_weapon.at_higher_levels: The damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.components: V, S, M (a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
sleep.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 6d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can put to sleep. Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this spell falls unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake the sleeper awake.
sleep.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

charm_person.name: Charm Person
charm_person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance; when the spell ends, it knows it was charmed by you.
charm_person.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 1st.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
thunderwave.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict_wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
inflict_wounds.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.components: V, S, M (a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it)
shield_of_faith.description: A shimmering field appears around a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage.
guiding_bolt.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
hold_person.description: Choose a humanoid you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
hold_person.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd.

web.name: Web
web.components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)
web.description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube for the duration. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area. Each creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them during its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw, becoming restrained on a failure until the webs are burned away or the spell ends.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.components: V, S, M (diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes)
revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

fly.name: Fly
fly.components: V, S, M (a wing feather from any bird)
fly.description: This spell gives the target a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still in the air, unless it can stop the fall.
fly.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up. The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against the creature has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet; otherwise disadvantage.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.description: A grappled creature's speed becomes 0. The condition ends if the grappler is incapacitated, or if the creature is removed from the grappler's reach.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: A frightened creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight. The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: A stunned creature is incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

fighter.name: Fighter
level_1_features: Fighting Style: Choose a fighting style specialty.
Second Wind: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again.

2: Action Surge: You can take one additional action on your turn. Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again.
5: Extra Attack: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
9: Indomitable: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail and must use the new roll. Once used, you must finish a long rest before using it again.
11: Extra Attack Improvement: Your Extra Attack now lets you attack three times instead of two.
13: Indomitable Improvement: You can use Indomitable twice per long rest instead of once.
17: Indomitable Improvement: You can use Indomitable three times per long rest instead of twice.
20: Extra Attack Improvement: Your Extra Attack now lets you attack four times instead of three.

wizard.name: Wizard
level_1_features: Spellcasting: You can cast wizard spells using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.
Arcane Recovery: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up).

18: Spell Mastery: Choose a 1st-level wizard spell and a 2nd-level wizard spell you know; you can cast each at its lowest level without expending a spell slot, regaining the use after a long rest.
20: Signature Spells: Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells you know; you can cast each once without expending a spell slot, regaining the use after a long rest.

rogue.name: Rogue
level_1_features: Expertise: Choose two of your skill proficiencies; your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks using them.
Sneak Attack: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage to a creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage, or another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it.
Thieves' Cant: You know this secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code.

2: Cunning Action: You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
5: Uncanny Dodge: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.
7: Evasion: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects; when you succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage.
11: Reliable Talent: Treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 for ability checks where you add your proficiency bonus.
14: Blindsense: You can sense hidden or invisible creatures within 10 feet of you.
15: Slippery Mind: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
18: Elusive: No attack roll can have advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.
20: Stroke of Luck: Once per long rest, turn a miss into a hit, or treat an ability check failure as a roll of 20.

cleric.name: Cleric
level_1_features: Spellcasting: You can cast cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.
Divine Domain: Choose a domain related to your deity, granting domain spells and features.

2: Channel Divinity: You gain a pool of divine effects fueled by Channel Divinity, usable once per short or long rest.
Turn Undead: As an action, present your holy symbol and force each undead of your choice within 30 feet to spend its turns trying to move away from you.
5: Destroy Undead: Undead turned by you automatically die if they have a challenge rating of 1/2 or lower.
6: Channel Divinity Improvement: You can use Channel Divinity twice per rest instead of once.
8: Destroy Undead Improvement: Destroy Undead now destroys turned undead of challenge rating 1 or lower.
10: Divine Intervention: You call upon your deity for divine intervention; roll percentile dice against a success chance equal to your cleric level. On a success, the deity intervenes and the ability is regained only after a week.
11: Destroy Undead Improvement: Destroy Undead now destroys turned undead of challenge rating 2 or lower.
14: Destroy Undead Improvement: Destroy Undead now destroys turned undead of challenge rating 3 or lower.
17: Destroy Undead Improvement: Destroy Undead now destroys turned undead of challenge rating 4 or lower.
18: Channel Divinity Improvement: You can use Channel Divinity three times per rest instead of twice.
20: Divine Intervention Improvement: Your calls for Divine Intervention succeed automatically, no roll required.

human.name: Human
traits: Versatile: humans have no single defining trait - just a well-rounded aptitude across every ability.

elf.name: Elf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Keen Senses: you have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry: you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Trance: elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Dwarven Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.
Stonecunning: whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

halfling.name: Halfling
traits: Lucky: when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Brave: you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: you can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

high_elf.name: High Elf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Keen Senses: you have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry: you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Trance: elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.
Elf Weapon Training: you have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
Cantrip: you know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.
Extra Language: you can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Keen Senses: you have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry: you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Trance: elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.
Elf Weapon Training: you have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
Fleet of Foot: your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.
Mask of the Wild: you can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

hill_dwarf.name: Hill Dwarf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Dwarven Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.
Stonecunning: whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.
Dwarven Toughness: your hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 again every time you gain a level.

mountain_dwarf.name: Mountain Dwarf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Dwarven Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.
Stonecunning: whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.
Dwarven Armor Training: you have proficiency with light and medium armor.

lightfoot_halfling.name: Lightfoot Halfling
traits: Lucky: when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Brave: you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: you can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.
Naturally Stealthy: you can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

stout_halfling.name: Stout Halfling
traits: Lucky: when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Brave: you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: you can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.
Stout Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

potion_of_healing.name: Potion of Healing
potion_of_healing.description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

candle.name: Candle
candle.description: Sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius for 1 hour.

climbers_kit.name: Climber's Kit
climbers_kit.description: Grants advantage on climbing checks when used.

component_pouch.name: Component Pouch
component_pouch.description: A pouch of small pockets for spell components with somatic/material requirements.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: Advantage on Strength checks where leverage helps.

healers_kit.name: Healer's Kit
healers_kit.description: 10 uses; stabilizes a dying creature without a roll.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.description: A spellcasting focus for a cleric.

holy_water.name: Holy Water
holy_water.description: Deals 2d6 radiant damage to a fiend or undead if thrown and shattered on it.

hooded_lantern.name: Hooded Lantern
hooded_lantern.description: Bright light in a 30-foot radius, burns 1 pint of oil per 6 hours.

hunting_trap.name: Hunting Trap
hunting_trap.description: A creature stepping on it takes 1d4 piercing damage and its speed becomes 0.

manacles.name: Manacles
manacles.description: DC 20 Dexterity check or DC 20 Strength check to escape without the key.

oil.name: Oil
oil.description: A one-pint flask; can be thrown as a splash weapon or burned as fuel.

pouch.name: Pouch
pouch.description: Holds up to 1/5 cubic foot or 6 lb. of material.

spellbook.name: Spellbook
spellbook.description: 100 blank pages for recording spells; a wizard's spellcasting focus and spell repository.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.description: Objects viewed through it are magnified to twice their size.

tinderbox.name: Tinderbox
tinderbox.description: Used to light torches, candles, campfires, etc.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: Sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius for 1 hour.

acid.name: Acid
acid.description: A vial; as an action, can be thrown up to 20 feet for 2d6 acid damage.

alchemists_fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
alchemists_fire.description: A flask; thrown for 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns until put out.

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
antitoxin.description: A vial; grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

ball_bearings.name: Ball Bearings
ball_bearings.description: A bag of 1,000; covers a 10-foot square in difficult, slippery terrain.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.description: A bag of 20; a creature entering the area takes 1 piercing damage and its speed is halved.

burglars_pack.name: Burglar's Pack
burglars_pack.description: Backpack, bag of 1,000 ball bearings, 10 feet of string, bell, 5 candles, crowbar, hammer, 10 pitons, hooded lantern, 2 flasks of oil, 5 days rations, tinderbox, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope.

diplomats_pack.name: Diplomat's Pack
diplomats_pack.description: Chest, 2 cases for maps/scrolls, fine clothes, ink, ink pen, lamp, 2 flasks of oil, 5 sheets of paper, vial of perfume, sealing wax, soap.

dungeoneers_pack.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
dungeoneers_pack.description: Backpack, crowbar, hammer, 10 pitons, 10 torches, tinderbox, 10 days rations, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope.

entertainers_pack.name: Entertainer's Pack
entertainers_pack.description: Backpack, bedroll, 2 costumes, 5 candles, 5 days rations, waterskin, disguise kit.

explorers_pack.name: Explorer's Pack
explorers_pack.description: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days rations, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope.

priests_pack.name: Priest's Pack
priests_pack.description: Backpack, blanket, 10 candles, tinderbox, alms box, 2 blocks of incense, censer, vestments, 2 days rations, waterskin.

scholars_pack.name: Scholar's Pack
scholars_pack.description: Backpack, book of lore, ink, ink pen, 10 sheets of parchment, small bag of sand, small knife.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves_tools.description: Proficiency grants bonuses to picking locks and disarming traps.

herbalism_kit.name: Herbalism Kit
herbalism_kit.description: Used to identify/apply herbs; needed to craft potions of healing and antitoxin.

disguise_kit.name: Disguise Kit
disguise_kit.description: Grants bonuses to convincingly alter your appearance.

forgery_kit.name: Forgery Kit
forgery_kit.description: Used to forge a document or seal.

navigators_tools.name: Navigator's Tools
navigators_tools.description: Used to chart a course and navigate by the stars.

poisoners_kit.name: Poisoner's Kit
poisoners_kit.description: Used to create and apply poisons.

potion_of_climbing.name: Potion of Climbing
potion_of_climbing.description: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour, and advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.

bag_of_holding.name: Bag of Holding
bag_of_holding.description: Holds up to 500 lb., not exceeding 64 cubic feet, in an extradimensional space; weighs 15 lb. regardless of contents.

cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_of_protection.description: +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn (requires attunement).

driftglobe.name: Driftglobe
driftglobe.description: A glass orb that can float and shed light on command (requires attunement).

immovable_rod.name: Immovable Rod
immovable_rod.description: A button locks the rod in place in midair or against a surface; it can hold up to 8,000 lb.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn (requires attunement).

rope_of_climbing.name: Rope of Climbing
rope_of_climbing.description: A 60-foot silk rope that animates on command to knot, unknot, or climb on its own.

wand_of_magic_missiles.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
wand_of_magic_missiles.description: While holding this wand, you can use an action to cast the magic missile spell from it (requires attunement).

+1_weapon.name: +1 Weapon
+1_weapon.description: A weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

+1_armor.name: +1 Armor
+1_armor.description: Armor granting a +1 bonus to AC while worn.
